reviewSamples.text: Rainey is awesome with our dog, and he absolutely loves her. He always comes home looking so handsome. What is nice about Canine Oasis is it doesn't feel like you're walking into a kennel where it is loud with dogs barking out of control. …

reviewSamples.text: My dog shadow has been going there for some years now. Of course he is nervous about groomers but he had a groomer before to where I had to physically take him out of the car to go get groomed. But when I take him to canine Oasis he comes …

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Brenda Elliott
reviewSamples.text: Rainny does such a great job with the fur babies.  Her shop is immaculate, does not smell, and she is so sweet and wonderful with her "customers" and their parents too.  I recommend her highly.  I could take my Ollie somewhere closer to my home but why take him to a place that is less clean or less personal?
